diagnosis: The Spring Batch restart endpoint allows any authenticated merchant user to trigger the restart of failed or abandoned settlement batch jobs by execution ID. An attacker can re-run settlement reconciliation routines for competitor merchant accounts, causing duplicate financial processing or ledger discrepancies.
